method: Weighted least-squares local F using original live bonds, polar proper rotation at both endpoints; mean corotated transverse relative displacement divided by r0. Rank-deficient local stars marked NOT MEASURED.
threshold_note: 0.15 shear is a diagnostic comparison scale only, NOT a critical skew or material failure criterion. kappa must also remain below original typed onset.
virtual_energy: Exact full endpoint-star re-minimization at fixed x after one original bond d->1, checked against independent complete evaluations. Not Gc, not certified fracture dissipation; do not sum single-bond removals as independent energies.
interpretation: Shear-dominant kinematics below stretch onset can exist, but their presence does not prove a physical failure blind spot. Simple shear stretches oblique bonds already. A calibrated 3D mixed-mode law and non-affine benchmark are required before changing the native criterion.
